The white device logo is blown up and left as a faint outline on a white background. The hand-and-phone photo is shrunk to a tiny strip next to an empty grey bar. The blue slanted panel sits empty in the middle, with huge dead white areas above and below. The only difference is that B's blue panel sits slightly higher than A's, which doesn't make either one better.
